author: IGN
description:
Most boss fights in Crimson Desert are tests of your reflexes and timing, but the encounter with Tenebrum in Chapter 4 is more of a riddle. If you’ve been following the in-game tutorials and finding yourself stuck doing zero damage to this sentient cloud of corruption, you aren't alone. Between misleading prompts and a boss that stays perpetually out of reach, Tenebrum can be one of the most frustrating early-game hurdles. Here is exactly how to catch the wind, expose its core, and end the fight in record time.

In this Crimson Desert boss guide, we break down the specific mechanics needed to defeat Tenebrum. We’ll show you why your standard sword combos are failing and how to utilize the arena’s updraft to gain the height necessary for an aerial assault. We also cover the specific keybindings for the Force Palm ability on both controller and PC, as well as the defensive maneuvers required to dodge Tenebrum’s devastating shockwave attack.

#ign #gaming
title: Crimson Desert: Tenebrum Boss Guide | EASY Strategy

Check out the trailer for Labyrinth, an upcoming anime film directed by Shoji Kawamori (Macross, The Vision of Escaflowne). Labyrinth stars girl group ATARASHII GAKKO!’s Suzuka as “Shiori Maezawa” in her voice acting debut, joined by Taizo Harada as “Komori” and Takuto Teranishi, from the boy group timelesz, in his debut acting role as “Suguru Kagami”.

Shiori is a typical high school student who dreams of online stardom, but struggles to capture attention. After an embarrassing video of her goes viral, she gets trapped in her smartphone and replaced by a charismatic alter ego. As the doppelganger charms the internet and devises a nefarious plot to replace mankind with brainrot, Shiori must partner with other online outcasts to stop her digital counterpart and reclaim her life in the real world.

Labyrinth will release in theaters for two nights only in Japanese with English subtitles and English-dubbed from May 10–11.
